description: Generate a video from text or an image using Runway ML. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video. Returns a task_id to poll for completion.

image_url.description: URL of an image to animate (image-to-video mode)

model.description: Model name: gen3a_turbo (fast) or gen3a (quality). Default: gen3a_turbo

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

name: runway_generate_video
